lines.text: In the third month, Israel left Rephidim, entered the Wilderness of Sinai, and camped in front of the mountain.
The LORD said He carried Israel on eagles' wings and that they would be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.
The LORD told Moses to have the people wash their clothes, and only a ram's horn blast would let them approach the mountain.
On the third day there was thunder and lightning, and Mount Sinai was wrapped in smoke like a firepot because the LORD descended in fire.
The LORD called Moses to the summit, then told him to go down and bring Hur with him.
